A user wants to fine-tune the pre- trained model on a regression task where the inputs are sentences but the labels are real-valued. The label values range from 0.1 to 2 with a step size of 0.1. Given these, choose the correct statements.
options: The objective function of the pre-trained model should be modified during fine-tuning
The objective function of the pre-trained model need not be modified during fine-tuning
